name: Podcast
description: Episodes with script and show notes drafted separately, judged on whether a listener stays past the first two minutes, scheduled into a feed and shipped as a release.

axes.description: Energy, pauses, whether it sounds read or spoken.

axes.description: Is there a moment worth clipping and sending to a friend?
